[[General/Legends|General]] '''Throom''' was a ground forces commander in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Throom's [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was completely covered in [[Water/Legends|water]], and the general attended a briefing on ground force command hosted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].
